# Design step D2a: tokens, shell and component kit Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** the design system as code in `web/`: tokens, fonts, status shapes and gap states, the app shell, and the kit of source components the pages need, each proven to open from `file://` under the content security policy.

**Architecture:** tokens live in one Tailwind `@theme` file generated by hand from the design system and checked against it by a test. Source components are copied from Untitled UI React and keep their source's look; pieces with no source are written here. A kit page (`#/kit`) renders every component and state, and the existing open-from-disk check loads it, so a component that breaks the policy fails the gate.

**Tech Stack:** React 19.3.0, Vite 6.4.5, Tailwind 4.3.3, TypeScript 5.9.3, Vitest 4.1.11, plus the packages in decision 0004 at exactly those versions.

**Spec:** `docs/design/design-system.md` (0.7), `docs/design/component-map.md`, `docs/decisions/0003-design-track.md`, `docs/decisions/0004-front-end-kit-dependencies.md`, `docs/decisions/0001-front-end-stack.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Mocks for reference: `docs/design/mocks/*.md`.

## Global Constraints

- Content security policy unchanged: `default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'`. No inline `<style>`, no runtime style injection, no CDN, no `fetch`. The DOM style object is allowed.
- Packages: only those in decision 0004, exact versions, no `^` or `~`. Nothing from React Bits, Radix, Base UI, Sonner, Shiki or `motion`. Only Untitled UI's free components; never `npx untitledui@latest login`.
- Source look (decision 0003): a copied component keeps its source's layout, sizes, radius and density. Only colour values, typefaces, status shapes, gap states and motion come from the design system. Page titles are 36px and judgement prose 16px.
- Every colour is a token; no hex outside `web/src/styles/theme.css`. Token names and values are exactly the design system's.
- Motion: one-off transitions at most 200 ms; only live run state loops; no animated numerals; all off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- A status is always shape, colour and word together. Missing is "n.a.", never 0.
- The front end computes no figure shown as text. A chart library may compute positions.
- No company name, tagline or wordmark. The logo is the predecessor's symbol file (`legacy` remote, `brand/symbol.svg`), committed as `web/public/symbol.svg`.
- Each PR is within 800 changed lines (lock file excluded). Copied source components count, so this step is a sequence of stacked PRs, one or two tasks each. Open each PR; merge none.
- `npm --prefix web run gates` exits 0 on every PR, on Windows and Linux in CI.
- No stub or fake value standing in for real behaviour. No catch-all that hides a failure. Every task report ends with a `Not verified:` line. The design system's tables are the answer key: the implementer does not edit `docs/`, and does not weaken a test that compares against it.
- Implement with `mx-feature` (`mx-scaffold` for Task 1's configuration); review each task with `mx-precise`. Whole-branch review per section 7 of the global rules before the last PR is offered for merge.

## Review Focus

1. A copied component injects a `<style>` tag or reads a font or image from a network: the open-from-disk check on the kit page must fail.
2. A token in `theme.css` drifts from the design system's table (name or hex): the token test fails.
3. Two states in one status set render the same shape, or a state renders with no word.
4. `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: the running halo and queued shimmer stop, and Running still differs from Finished by shape.
5. A chart with a missing value draws a gap, not a zero; a series beyond the sixth folds into "Other".

It also asserts no hex in `theme.css` is absent from `docs/design/brand-tokens.md`, and that no file under `web/src` other than `theme.css` contains a hex colour.

## Done when

`npm --prefix web run gates` exits 0 on the last PR on Windows and Linux; the kit page opened from disk shows every component and state of the design system with no policy violation; the token and status tests pass against the design system as answer key. The final report lists the PRs in order, says whether Recharts passed the trial, and ends with `Not verified:`.

## Not verified by this plan

- Prior art: the owner's `caos-workbench/frontend` was the source of the stack pins (decision 0001); no other repository of the owner's was searched for a reusable kit, and no public search was run, because the kit is copied from the approved sources by ruling.
- Untitled UI's CLI output was not run in advance: the file paths under `web/src/components/` in Tasks 4, 5 and 7 are where its documentation says components land, not observed.
- Whether each free component named exists under that CLI name.
